purpose: Decide source-backed target values for U-ITEM-HW100 Product Posting Group and VAT Product Posting Group before any item-card write, VAT setup, General Posting Setup, document, Preview Posting or Posting.
sourceEvidence: TARGET-036E2 proves U-ITEM-HW100 / Universaarl Hardware 100 with Base Unit STK after reopen.
TARGET-049 proves WARE / Warenbestand as Item Posting Group after reopen.
TARGET-050 proves Inventory Posting Setup SAAR-HL + WARE + 1140 after reopen.
TARGET-051 proves WARE visible on U-ITEM-HW100 after reopen.
TARGET-052 proves Product Posting Group and VAT Product Posting Group field terms are visible on U-ITEM-HW100, but values remain unproven and unassigned.

smartDecision.whyNow: TARGET-052 shows the remaining item-card posting fields. Writing values without a source-backed decision would make later VAT and General Posting Setup evidence weaker.
smartDecision.fallback: If target values cannot be source-backed, park item writes and run a source/UI discovery case instead.

acceptanceCriteria: Candidate Product Posting Group and VAT Product Posting Group values are selected or explicitly blocked.
Decision cites existing Universaarl evidence and source registry / Microsoft Learn mapping.
The next write case is created only if field values and boundaries are clear.
No setup, master data, document, Preview Posting or Posting occurs.

nextStepDecision.lastEvidenceSummary: TARGET-052 showed U-ITEM-HW100 with STK, FIFO, WARE and visible but empty Product Posting Group and VAT Product Posting Group fields. TARGET-045A had already mapped WAREN and VAT19 as candidates with setup boundaries.
nextStepDecision.reason: The item-card write must not happen until WAREN and VAT19 are source-backed and their setup limitations are documented.

lookaheadReviewed.reason: The two target values are now selected, but only for a narrow item-card write with before/after screenshot and reopen proof.
VAT Posting Setup remains required after item VAT product value assignment; it must not be merged into TARGET-054.
General Posting Setup INLAND/WAREN remains required after item product value assignment; it must not be merged into TARGET-054.
O2C remains blocked until customer/item posting fields plus VAT and General Posting Setup are ready enough for a preflight.
Vendor numbering is parked and unrelated to the current item foundation lane.

queueChangesMade: Added TARGET-054 as the next narrow controlled item-card write gate.
nextStepDecision.whySelectedNextCaseIsBest: It converts the source decision into exactly one bounded field assignment step before returning to VAT and General Posting Setup lanes.
risksBeforeNextCase: Do not change setup pages in TARGET-054.
Do not create documents or run Preview Posting.
Do not claim posting readiness after setting item fields.
requiredPreparation: Use the item card route from TARGET-052.
Capture before screenshot with both empty fields visible.
Stop if the wrong item, wrong company, search overlay, wizard, dialog or hidden field state appears.

productPostingGroup.reason: WAREN is already proven as a General Product Posting Group and matches the Universaarl goods/hardware starter item. It is not enough to claim General Posting Setup or posting readiness.

vatProductPostingGroup.reason: VAT19 is the source-backed 19 percent VAT product-group candidate and is visible from the VAT setup lane. It is not enough to claim VAT Posting Setup, VAT calculation or VAT entry readiness.
